verdict.rationale: First-party durable-execution docs say Pydantic AI agents can preserve progress across API failures, application errors and restarts, and can handle long-running, asynchronous and human-in-the-loop workflows. The homepage adds that the same agent can run on a durable background queue, and deferred tools allow execution outside the same Python process. A community note on serializing and deserializing conversations as JSON supports state persistence. Missing for 10: the specific durable-execution integrations are not named in the evidence, survival across deploys is not detailed, and no independent hands-on report confirms durable runs across restarts.
